Two Companies to Manufacture 80 Vande Bharat Sleeper Trains

Two companies have been selected to manufacture 80 Vande Bharat sleeper train sets. These companies will also be responsible for the maintenance of the trains for 35 years. The development involves the production of a new sleeper variant of the Vande Bharat Express, with details on routes, timings, and beneficiaries expected to be announced.
